english: Drone Auto-Loot Module

Your drone rifles through zombie loot bags and containers and picks up dropped items as it follows you, opening them with your own loot stage and Lucky Looter. Loot goes into the drone's storage. Higher-quality modules reach farther and act faster.

Drone Auto-Salvage Module

Your drone wrenches nearby salvageable objects (cars, sinks, working machines) apart as it follows you, into its own storage. Only touches unclaimed ground, never anyone's land claim, so it will not wreck your base. Higher-quality modules reach farther and act faster.

Drone Auto-Harvest Module

Your drone reaps grown crops in your land claim and replants them as it follows you, into its own storage. Only works your own claim, and leaves the seed replanted so the plot keeps producing. Higher-quality modules reach farther and act faster.
Drone Auto-Harvest Module Schematic

Drone Auto-Repair Module

Your drone repairs damaged blocks in your land claim as it follows you, paying the repair materials out of its own storage. Only works your own claim, and only repairs a block if it can pay in full. Higher-quality modules reach farther and act faster.
Drone Auto-Repair Module Schematic

Drone Auto-Plant Module

Your drone sows young crops from its own storage onto empty farm plots in your land claim as it follows you. Pairs with the Auto-Harvest Module, which deposits the seed crops it needs, for a self-running farm. Only plants on your own claim, never on invalid ground. Higher-quality modules reach farther and act faster.

Drone Overclock Module

An enhancement module: it does no work of its own, but speeds up every other automation module installed in the drone, so each chore takes less time. Higher-quality Overclock modules speed things up more. Uses one of the drone's limited mod slots, so it trades against fitting another automation module.

Drone Wide-Band Antenna Module

An enhancement module: it does no work of its own, but widens the working range of every other automation module installed in the drone. Higher-quality Antenna modules reach farther. Uses one of the drone's limited mod slots, so it trades against fitting another automation module.
